meta.name: ship
meta.description: Prepare or execute an authorized controlled release with verified checks, recovery and an operating owner. Use when a customer increment is ready for deployment.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把已就绪的版本经核对与回滚预案后正式发布上线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有一个客户增量已就绪、准备部署
copy.tagline_en: Release a ready increment to production with verified checks and a rollback plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a customer increment is ready and waiting to be deployed

howto.what: 装上后，它按方法准备或执行一次授权过的受控发布：核实检查项、恢复方案和运维负责人，并把实现、验证、部署与验收区分清楚，未跑通的检查如实报告。
howto.when: 当客户增量可以部署时触发；若由 @fde 调用，则沿用它当前的脱敏数据包和范围，不重新走发现和提问。

say.text: 这个客户增量可以部署了，帮我准备一次受控发布。
say.note: 会先读任务上下文契约与方法，再列检查项

say.text: 执行这次发布，并写清恢复方案和运维负责人。
say.note: 按方法执行，并区分部署与验收

say.text: 检查项没跑通就先别发，如实说明缺什么能力。
say.note: 它会如实报告未运行的检查，不假装已通过

howto.what_en: Once installed, it prepares or runs an authorized controlled release: verified checks, recovery, and an operating owner, keeping implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance distinct.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a customer increment is ready for deployment. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting discovery.

say_en.text: This customer increment is ready to deploy - prepare a controlled release.
say_en.note: Reads the task context contract and method first

say_en.text: Run the release and state the recovery plan and operating owner.
Hold the release if a check hasn't run; say what capability is missing.
